title: cli: drop the never-loaded @oclif/plugin-help and @oclif/plugin-plugins from oclif.plugins, and correct every published text that says `os plugins` works
body:
Filing-gate class: ③ maintainer-directed task.
Body last written 2026-10-02T01:43Z: the spec TSDoc sentence was split out to the spec-lane card #21286; this card does not touch `packages/spec`.
Routing: the maintainer direct-dispatch channel (`session_018gA1pE6eJtwHhqx72G8U9X`) routes this card to `domain:cli` and `area:devpath`; triage grades the priority.
Acting reader: the maintainer direct-dispatch session (`Seat: domain:devx#3`), which dispatches one `os-dev`.
Dedup: I listed 558 objectstack issues and PRs over REST (open, plus the most recently updated closed) and grepped titles and bodies for `oclif.plugins`, `os plugins install`, `plugin-plugins` and `plugin-help`. The only hits are today's version bump (#21125 / PR #21212) and the Dependabot PRs it replaced (#21031, #21035). None removes the entries.

## Maintainer ruling (verbatim)

> 同意：`oclif.plugins`: 里面那两个插件只装在 devDependencies,所以从来没加载过,`os help` 和 `os plugins` 都不是可用命令。我建议删掉这两条配置。

Given in session `session_018gA1pE6eJtwHhqx72G8U9X` on 2026-10-02, in reply to the seat's recommendation after #21212 landed.

## Measured (at `origin/main` `c7396f1a9`)

- `packages/cli/package.json` → `oclif.plugins` lists `@oclif/plugin-help` and `@oclif/plugin-plugins`. Both packages appear only in `devDependencies` (`^7.0.2`, `^7.0.3`).
- oclif's core-plugin loader matches `oclif.plugins` names only against `dependencies`, so neither plugin ever loads:
  - `bin/run.js:84-94` records the measurement: `os --help` lists 34 topics, and none of them is `plugins`.
  - #21212's dev re-measured on `@oclif/core` 5.1.2: the root help lists no plugins and no help topic.
- Text that names this configuration or the commands it was meant to supply:
  - `content/docs/plugins/index.mdx:400-408`;
  - `packages/cli/README.md` `### os plugins (oclif)` (about line 206) and `## oclif Plugin System` (about lines 216-277);
  - `packages/cli/bin/run.js:84-94`;
  - `packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts:2377-2380` and `doctor-deprecation-hint-commands.test.ts:15`;
  - `packages/cli/test/plugin-commands.test.ts:22-23`;
  - `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json:658`;
  - `packages/spec/src/kernel/cli-extension.zod.ts:17-18`, plus its generated page `content/docs/references/kernel/cli-extension.mdx:21` (carried by #21286, not this card).

## What to do

1. **Remove the `plugins` array** from `oclif` in `packages/cli/package.json`. Change no other `oclif` key.
2. **The two devDependencies exist only to back that array.**
   - Measure every remaining consumer: imports, `require`, scripts, fixtures. A name inside a comment is not a consumer.
   - If none remains, remove both from `devDependencies` and regenerate `pnpm-lock.yaml` with the repo's tooling. ⛔ Never hand-edit it.
   - Lockfile acceptance: only those two subtrees leave, and no resolved version goes DOWN against the merge base.
   - If a real consumer exists, keep them and report it.
   - (This is the seat's reading of the ruling: it removes the dead surface whole, and stops Dependabot proposing majors for packages nothing loads, as #21031 and #21035 did on 2026-10-01.)
3. **Behaviour acceptance: nothing an operator sees changes**, because the plugins never loaded.
   - Show `os --help` and the full command list byte-identical before and after.
   - Take a positive control first: show that the reading would catch a real difference.
4. **Fix the published text this change makes false or touches.** Each site gets a conclusion in the PR body: changed; already true (with evidence); or out of scope (with the reason). No site is skipped silently.
   - `content/docs/plugins/index.mdx` callout. Its stated reason ("lists `@oclif/plugin-plugins` under `oclif.plugins`, but the package sits in `devDependencies`") becomes false. Restate the fact as it will be: `@objectstack/cli` ships no plugin manager, `os plugins …` and `os help` are not commands, and `os --help` is the help entry. Keep the build-your-own-distribution route only if it is still true.
   - `packages/cli/README.md`: `### os plugins (oclif)` and `## oclif Plugin System` describe `os plugins install/uninstall/update` as available, which is false. Correct them.
   - `packages/cli/bin/run.js:84-94`: its reasoning names the `devDependencies` placement. Restate it to the new fact.
   - `doctor.ts:2377-2380` and `doctor-deprecation-hint-commands.test.ts:15` say "neither bundled plugin … supplies one". After this change there is no bundled plugin. Restate.
   - `test/plugin-commands.test.ts:22-23` asserts both entries are present. Rewrite it to pin the new truth (no `oclif.plugins`, no plugin manager). ⛔ Do not just delete the guard.
   - `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json:658`: the evidence text names the array's contents.
   - ⛔ Not this card: `packages/spec/src/kernel/cli-extension.zod.ts:17-18` and its generated page `content/docs/references/kernel/cli-extension.mdx:21` ("or users install it via `os plugins install <pkg>`"). That sentence sits on the spec contract surface, which is spec-lane work. It is carried by #21286. Leave both files untouched.
5. **Changeset:** a `patch` for `@objectstack/cli` (its published manifest's `oclif` field and its README). Not `skip-changeset`.

## Out of scope (a separate maintainer question)

With no plugin manager and no listed plugins, the CLI-extension protocol in `cli-extension.zod.ts` (`OclifPluginConfig`) describes a capability no `os` user can reach today, short of building their own `os` distribution. Whether to deliver it (a plugin manager as a real dependency) or retire the protocol (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove) goes to the maintainer separately. ⛔ This card corrects false sentences only. It changes no schema or export.
